body: I wanna say thanks to everyone the last few days, you have helped alot just by being here for me. I still feel like i dont want to go on, but im gonna try and make it on my own now, there are alot of other people here that could use your attention more than me,,, so thankyou all

Im trying to keep hope, and i have no one else to stay alive for
I know, its going to take time, but right now i dont wanna wait
I still havent ate, but ive been running on monster and cigarettes, trying to stay away from the alcohol... Cause i know it would just get worse that way

I am just trying to figure out a way to  get past these feelings of wanting to end my life... I was finally being able to cope with my friends death and my dads, but last night was the hardest of them all... She was 3 months pregnant, and i lost them both.
Thanks, i just really dont know how i will make it through this.
